figures.name: Cybele

ability.name: Mountain Mother's Roar
ability.description: Summon two lion guardians (6/7/7/5/5 each); enemy cannot target this card while they stand.

figures.description: The Great Mother goddess of wild nature who rides her chariot pulled by lions and demands total devotion.

figures.name: Attis

ability.name: Death and Resurrection
ability.description: When this card is destroyed, resurrect it at the start of your next turn with 5 HP.

figures.description: Divine consort of Cybele who dies and is reborn, embodying the eternal cycle of vegetation dying in winter.

figures.name: Sabazios (Phrygian)

ability.name: Serpent Passage
ability.description: Grant one ally +3 magic; that ally is immune to poison for the battle.

figures.description: Sky god whose ecstatic mysteries involved passing a serpent through the initiate's clothing as a divine sign.

figures.name: Midas

ability.name: Golden Touch
ability.description: Transform one enemy into gold: they cannot act but also cannot be destroyed for 2 turns.

figures.description: King whose wish for the golden touch brought ruin and whose ass's ears revealed Apollo's secret.

figures.name: Agdistis

ability.name: Dual Nature
ability.description: Choose this card's alignment each turn: light or dark, gaining different abilities.

figures.description: Hermaphroditic divine being of monstrous power castrated by the gods, whose blood became the almond tree.

figures.name: Ma

ability.name: Earth War
ability.description: Deal 4 damage to all enemies; grant all allies +2 defense.

figures.description: Phrygian war and earth goddess whose cult merged with Cybele and spread through the Roman world.

figures.name: Gordios

ability.name: Gordian Knot
ability.description: Bind one enemy in an impossible tangle: they cannot act until the knot is cut by a power-10 card.

figures.description: Legendary founder king of Phrygia whose cart-knot prophesied rule of all Asia to whoever could untie it.

figures.name: Lityerses

ability.name: Harvester's Scythe
ability.description: Deal 4 damage to one enemy and return 2 HP to this card.

figures.description: Monstrous harvester son of Midas who killed strangers by forcing them to compete in reaping before beheading them.

figures.name: Marsyas

ability.name: Piping Challenge
ability.description: Force a musical duel: if enemy has higher wisdom they win, otherwise deal 5 damage.

figures.description: Satyr flute-player who challenged Apollo to a musical contest, lost, and was flayed alive for his arrogance.

figures.name: Hecate (Phrygian)

ability.name: Triple Crossroads
ability.description: Choose any 3 of the following: +2 power, +2 defense, +2 speed, +2 magic, +2 wisdom for one ally.

figures.description: The triple goddess of crossroads and magic was deeply rooted in Phrygian tradition before spreading to Greece.

figures.name: Galli Priest

ability.name: Sacred Ecstasy
ability.description: Inflict ecstasy on all enemies; allies gain +2 magic for 1 turn from devotion.

figures.description: Castrated priests of Cybele who danced in wild frenzy, played clashing cymbals and cut themselves in trance.

figures.name: Phrygian Rooster

ability.name: Dawn Crow
ability.description: Prevent all enemy ambush abilities from activating at the start of battle.

figures.description: Sacred rooster of Cybele whose crowing heralds the dawn and whose sacred nature was carried into Roman cult.

figures.name: Nana

ability.name: Almond Blossom
ability.description: Restore 3 HP to one ally; grant them immunity to poison for 1 turn.

figures.description: Virgin goddess who conceived Attis by placing an almond or pomegranate blossom against her breast.

figures.name: Thetis (Phrygian aspect)

ability.name: Silver Veil
ability.description: Wrap one ally: they absorb the next 4 damage and return it as magic.

figures.description: The sea goddess aspect worshipped in Phrygian coastal tradition as a protective silver-footed figure.

figures.name: Phrygian Dragon

ability.name: Earth Serpent
ability.description: Burrow: move underground and emerge under any enemy dealing 5 damage.

figures.description: The great earth-serpent guardian of Phrygian sacred sites whose coils protected the ancient oracle.

figures.name: Pessinus Idol

ability.name: Meteor Stone
ability.description: Deal 4 magic damage that bypasses all physical defense.

figures.description: The sacred black meteorite stone that was Cybele's divine body, transported to Rome during the Punic Wars.

figures.name: Telesphoros

ability.name: Hooded Healer
ability.description: Remove one debuff from any ally and restore 2 HP.

figures.description: Hooded child-spirit of convalescence associated with the healing sanctuaries of Phrygia.

figures.name: Phrygian Warrior

ability.name: Cavalry Charge
ability.description: Deal 5 damage to one enemy; push them to the back row.

figures.description: The archetypal Phrygian warrior on horseback whose image appears on countless votive reliefs.

figures.name: Aglauros

ability.name: Dew Offering
ability.description: All allies gain a dew shield absorbing 2 damage for 1 turn.

figures.description: Dew goddess who threw herself from the citadel to save her city from an oracle's demand for sacrifice.

figures.name: Manes

ability.name: Ancestral Voice
ability.description: Summon one ancestor ghost with matching stats to a fallen ally for 1 turn.

figures.description: The ancestral dead of Phrygia who rise to counsel and protect the living in times of great need.
